summary: Range check helper: delegates to ShortComputation_6720(this) to obtain an integer value and returns true only when that value lies in the inclusive range [2, 3]. No side effects; reads state only through the callee.

operations.description: Call ShortComputation_6720(this) and store its integer result in v1.
Compare the delegated result: return true only when v1 >= 2 and v1 <= 3.
Return the boolean result of the range comparison (v1 in [2, 3]).
